attention.name: attention
attention.description: Something waiting on you: a promote, money past the cap, a credential, a question mid-mission.

milestone.name: milestone
milestone.description: A stage of a mission: which steps of the build loop, over which thing or operation, and how far.

mission.name: mission
mission.description: A goal: milestones of tasks over the blueprint, taken as far as one environment.

person.name: person
person.description: Someone who signs in. Better Auth keeps people; work refers to them by id.

question.name: question
question.description: Something the manager needs you to decide before the mission starts, taken from a gap in the blueprint.

run.name: run
run.description: One agent working one task: which agent type, on which model, with what budget.

attention.approve.name: attention.approve
attention.approve.description: Say yes. For a promote, the promote runs.

attention.decline.name: attention.decline
attention.decline.description: Say not yet, and why. The task stays where its facts put it.

attention.list.name: attention.list
attention.list.description: List attentions, newest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, state.

attention.raise.name: attention.raise
attention.raise.description: Ask the mission's owner for a decision only they can make.

milestone.add.name: milestone.add
milestone.add.description: Add a milestone to a mission. Its tasks appear at once: its kinds over its subject.

milestone.drop.name: milestone.drop
milestone.drop.description: Drop a milestone from its mission's scope. Its tasks leave the board; the burn-down shows the step.

milestone.list.name: milestone.list
milestone.list.description: List milestones, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, state.

mission.finish.name: mission.finish
mission.finish.description: Close the mission: every task is closed by a fact up to its target.

mission.get.name: mission.get
mission.get.description: Read one mission by its id: owner, title, target, blueprint, state.

mission.list.name: mission.list
mission.list.description: List missions, newest first, 20 to a page, filtered by owner, state.

mission.open.name: mission.open
mission.open.description: Open a mission over the blueprint revision named. The manager starts by asking about the blueprint's gaps.

mission.resume.name: mission.resume
mission.resume.description: Pick a paused mission up again.

mission.start.name: mission.start
mission.start.description: Start the mission once intake is done. From here the manager only orchestrates.

mission.stop.name: mission.stop
mission.stop.description: Stop the mission for good. Its runs are stopped with it.

mission.tasks.name: mission.tasks
mission.tasks.description: The mission's tasks, each in the column its facts put it in.
blanks: steps.facts: read eval rows, verdicts and compiled revisions from the logbook: a declared dependency (L3.01)

question.answer.name: question.answer
question.answer.description: Answer a question with one of its letters.

question.ask.name: question.ask
question.ask.description: Ask the mission's owner about one gap in the blueprint, with lettered answers.

question.list.name: question.list
question.list.description: List questions, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, state.

question.spike.name: question.spike
question.spike.description: Not sure yet: turn the question into a spike task on its subject.

run.fail.name: run.fail
run.fail.description: The run gave up, saying why.

run.finish.name: run.finish
run.finish.description: The run pushed its branch. CI proves it; the run cannot close its own task.

run.list.name: run.list
run.list.description: List runs, newest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, task, state.

run.report.name: run.report
run.report.description: Say how the run is going. It moves no card.

run.start.name: run.start
run.start.description: Start an agent on one task. The run claims the task until it ends.

run.stop.name: run.stop
run.stop.description: Stop the run. A person's act, or the mission stopping.

mission.tasks: steps.facts: read eval rows, verdicts and compiled revisions from the logbook: a declared dependency (L3.01)

test.name: test
test.runs: a fresh world for each pull request
